name: Lars Christensen
original_name: ラース・クリステンセン
source:
"I'll definitely protect you, because when you're beside me I feel relieved."

Thumbelina's childhood friend who lives next door to her.
His family is poor so he makes a living selling matches.
He's a bit of a apathetic and sulky person, but at his root he is kind.
He's going on an adventure with Thumbelina.
